description: Delete one folder. Nothing inside is lost: its items and sub-folders move up to its parent, or to "other" at the top level. Only do it when the reader asked; to empty a folder without deleting it move its items with driftnet_move_items, and to rename it use driftnet_update_folder. Ids are stable lowercase slugs (e.g. 'games', or a generated 'f-…' id for names without Latin letters) that don't change on rename; sub-folders keep their own ids when they move up; "other" is the catch-all and can't be deleted. No tool can undo it, so confirm with the reader first. Fails if the folder does not exist.
name: driftnet_delete_folder
title: Delete a folder
